record.one_liner: A suite of SDKs and APIs including a REST API and Canvas Kit framework to build private or public apps and integrations for Intercom.

auth_methods.quote: These apps have access to other peoples' Intercom data, which means there are specific requirements in order to publish them, such as setting up OAuth and submitting to the Intercom team for review.

access_test.quote: To develop a public app you will need to use a development workspace: sign up here to create your free account.

access_ship.quote: Once development is done and OAuth is configured, in the Developer Hub of your [Production] app you can choose the listing type , provide installation URLs , and follow the steps outlined in this guide to submit it for review.

api_type.quote: If you aren't able to find an existing app that solves the problem you're facing, you can build your own using our REST APIs and Canvas Kit framework.
